law: ABORT (any cause, any phase): the ECU de-energises the NC valve latch at once (spring closes the ball valve) and commands the pintle closed at the drive speed in parallel; torch solenoids closed; no in-flight relight retry (lead decision 2026-10-13). NORMAL shutdowns (MECO after the 72 % throttle-down, touchdown cut) keep the pintle-first sequence

finding: with the 21.4 cm3 valve-to-seat line (16-18 g of liquid N2O at 15-25 C) the closing pintle is fed from the line after the valve shuts at every level checked: the abort tail-off equals the pintle-only one (the parallel valve closure does not shorten it); the valve matters for what follows (no further tank flow, trapped-liquid relief)
